currency.note: Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026 and became the 21st euro-area member, so this row's currency is EUR: read at the ECB press release of 2026-01-01, the European Commission page "Bulgaria and the euro", and the Council decision of 2025-07-08 that set the irrevocable rate at 1.95583 BGN per EUR.

tariff.note: Eurostat nrg_pc_204, household consumption band 2500-4999 kWh/year, all taxes included, reference period 2026-S1 (dataset updated 2026-10-19), read at the Eurostat API on 2026-11-08. A published point statistic, so lo, mid and hi are the same number rather than a spread invented around it. Euro-area membership for this country was itself verified at source on 2026-11-08, because a price cited in EUR is only native once the country uses the euro.
